title: ci(security): reduce check workflow token privileges
body:
The compromise impact of a check job should be as small as practical. A step that only needs source access should not receive broad authority by habit.

## Open questions

We still need to inspect `scripts/check.sh`; it is not included here, so its downstream write needs remain unknown.

files.patch:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/check.yml b/.github/workflows/check.yml
--- a/.github/workflows/check.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/check.yml
@@ -1,8 +1,7 @@
 name: checks
 on: [push, pull_request]
 permissions:
-  contents: write
-  issues: write
+  contents: read
 jobs:
   unit:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest

diff --git a/docs/check-workflow.md b/docs/check-workflow.md
--- a/docs/check-workflow.md
+++ b/docs/check-workflow.md
@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@
 # Check workflow
 
-The check job receives repository-content and issue write permissions.
+The check job receives repository-content read permission.
+Issue permissions are not requested; the workflow does not post issue comments.
